findings.summary: In SevenZipExtractor.extract, an empty targets list (all entries blocked or empty archive) may be treated by py7zr as no filter, extracting everything including path-traversal entries and defeating the fix.

judge.reason: Speculative about py7zr behavior with empty targets; unverifiable and not the answer-key bug.

findings.label: unsure

findings.summary: archive.list() is called before extract(), and py7zr readers may be consumed or reset by earlier reads, so extract() may not work afterwards; this needs checking.

judge.reason: Speculative 'may' claim with no concrete defect shown.

findings.label: false_alarm

findings.summary: RarExtractor.safemembers/badlink unpacks info.file_redir, which is None for RAR3 symlinks, raising TypeError and failing extraction instead of skipping the entry.

judge.reason: Possible TypeError on file_redir None, cannot verify from given information.

findings.label: unsure

findings.summary: badpath in the zip, rar and 7z extractors uses startswith(base) without a trailing separator, so sibling directories like /out/data_evil pass the check; the weakness is copied from the tar code into three more places.

judge.reason: Describes the sibling-prefix startswith bug, but candidates is empty so it cannot be linked to b1.

findings.label: valid_other

findings.summary: The rar badlink validates the link target against the link's own directory instead of the extraction root, wrongly blocking harmless links such as ../sibling.

judge.reason: Link target validated relative to link directory may be intended; cannot verify.

findings.label: unsure

findings.summary: The 7z badlink is dead code because its only call site is commented out.

judge.reason: Dead code is not an incorrect behavior defect.

findings.label: false_alarm
